Amidst the sprawling cityscape, a solitary figure stands at the edge of a rooftop garden. cripples of sunlight dance through the leaves of the olive trees that dot the space. A gentle breeze carries the scent of the earth, a stark contrast to the steel and glass that encase the city below.

The figure, lost in thought, overlooks the city's heartbeat. Yet, in this moment, the heartbeat is a distant drum, and the figure finds solace in the quietude of the garden.
